newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Cariplo sees 1996 profits slide.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Cariplo sees 1996 profits slide.

text.p: Italy's largest saving bank Cariplo, which is aiming for privatisation this year, reported a sharp fall in net consolidated profits to nine billion lire in 1996 from 341 billion lire in 1995.
The Milan-based banking group was hit by large restructuring charges in 1996 linked largely to the company's acquisition of two smaller banks.
But Cariplo confirmed in a statement that it had made progress in the first months of 1997, and it expected better operating and economic results for this year.
The statement said that 1996 net interest income fell 3.1 percent to 3.206 trillion lire, while operating income rose some 4.8 percent to 4.639 trillion lire.
